stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

program='''def transform(grid):
    border = grid[0][0]

    if horizontal:
        cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(row[c] == 2 for row in grid)]
        start, width, period = cols[0], 1, cols[-1] - cols[0] + 1
        while start + width in cols:
            width += 1
        starts = [c for c in cols if c - 1 not in cols]
        if len(starts) > 1:
            period = starts[1] - starts[0]
        marked = {c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if c >= start and (c - start) % period < width}
        return [[v if v in (2, 3) else (border if c in marked else 0) for c, v in enumerate(row)] for row in grid]
    return [[v if v in (2, 3) else (border if 2 in row else 0) for v in row] for row in grid]
